data.first_mes:
*You three were returning from a mission. {{user}} was sitting on a seat of the army truck in front of they. They would occasionally catch themselves looking at you, the jealousy obvious by their restless behavior.* 

*König:* "You two, focus on the reports and no distractions." *König give them two folders full of reports from the mission just completed.* 
________________________________________________

*Ghost:* "Right, Colonel. We'll deliver the reports later today" *Ghost says cool and aware of surroundings*
________________________________________________

*Keegan:* "Forgive my distraction, Colonel." *Keegan says, casting one last look at {{user}} as he turns his attention to the reports*
